copyFailed: Could not copy. Select the text shown and copy it.

artifact.hint: One per deliverable: `[name](location) — what it is, revision`. The location is a relative path inside the task folder, an absolute path for code, otherwise a URL or a branch and commit. Put the description of the contents in the linked file. Attach a diff as `![diff](changes.patch)` only when the user decides by reading the wording itself.
artifact.title: Deliverables

conclusion.hint: What the parent and the list need to know, in 3 sentences: what was found, what was decided, the recommendation, and whether an answer is awaited. Screen details and numbers go in the notes or deliverables. Do not repeat what a question says.
conclusion.title: Conclusion

conditions.hint: One per condition: `<condition> — met|not met|unchecked (where the evidence is)`. Evidence details and test counts go in the linked file.
conditions.title: Done conditions

decide.hint: Write only when something needs deciding. One question at a time: what to decide, the choices (name and description) and a note. Numbers follow the order. The first word of a choice’s name (up to its first space) becomes its answer button and answer word; do not repeat it within a question, and do not start a name with `stop` or `other`, which the app keeps. The answer arrives as `<number>-<first word of the name>` with any words added; `<number>-other` says none of the choices, with what to do instead. Clear it with null once answered.
decide.title: Questions

decide_choice_detail.hint: In 3 lines: what changes if chosen and what is weak. Images as `![subject or action](relative path in the task)`, one per line. Review history and the steps after choosing go in the notes.
decide_choice_detail.title: Description

decide_choice_recommended.hint: Only on the one choice you recommend: why, in one sentence. The screen marks that choice as recommended.
decide_choice_recommended.title: Recommended

decide_note.hint: Shared assumptions, links to samples and when things stop. Do not repeat the choices’ descriptions or review notes.
decide_note.title: Note

decide_question.hint: One sentence on what to choose. Background goes in the note.
decide_question.title: What to decide

decide_stop.hint: Only when stopping the task is one of the options: what stopping means here, in 3 lines. It is offered as a choice of its own (`<number>-stop`), and whoever picks it stops the task instead of answering. Do not write it as one of the choices.
decide_stop.title: Stop

forbidden.hint: What this task alone must not do. Leave out what the project policy already forbids. Write nothing if there is none.
forbidden.title: Forbidden

goal.hint: One deciding sign that the task is done: what must be in place. Means go in Policy; what not to do goes in Forbidden.
goal.title: Goal

left_running.hint: One per thing running now: what, where, when it stops, and the one command that stops it. Write `none` if there is none. How to restart and clean up goes in files in the task folder.
left_running.title: Running processes

notes.hint: What the next agent needs to carry on: the decisions in effect and why, one line on how a decision changed (rejected options and why), unchecked points that could change a decision, and the next step and where. Commands, test counts and work steps go in files in the task folder, linked from the deliverables.
notes.title: Notes

policy.hint: Key points of how this task is approached. History and reasons go in the notes. Do not copy the project policy.
policy.title: Policy

pr.hint: Only when a PR (MR) was opened: one URL per PR.
pr.title: PR (MR)

project_policy.hint: What you write here goes as is into the instructions of every piece of work in this project. For example: how you like work done (what may be left to agents and what to ask you about), and what must not be done.
project_policy.title: Project policy

project_summary.hint: One sentence on what this project is for: the kind of work that belongs in it. It is listed beside the project’s name, where it is read to choose the project a new request goes under, and it goes above the project policy into the instructions of every piece of work in this project. How the work is done goes in the project policy.
project_summary.title: Project summary

remaining.hint: One per piece of work left: `<what> — <who / waiting for what>` (the condition to resume). Steps and commands go in files in the task folder. Remove what is done.
remaining.title: Remaining work

size.textList_one: About {{chars}} characters each, up to {{count}} item.
size.textList_other: About {{chars}} characters each, up to {{count}} items.

user_instructions.hint: On the top task, the user’s statements and decisions that still apply, as `<date hh:mm> “original words”` (the user’s local time, 24-hour clock, e.g. `2026-11-11 09:06 “…”`). Fold the same point into its latest one and add how it got there, like “(3 options → B → option 1)”. Quote only the key part of a long statement. Leave out replaced statements, interim options, commands and attachment descriptions (the original stays in History). Goes into the launch prompts of every task below.
user_instructions.title: User instructions
